commit.author: Nic <nmweber@uw.edu>
commit.message:
Update multiple data sources, fix R CMD check failures (#50)

* Update action versions

* Update NSF/NIH dates to include more results

* Add warning if arnold has maxed out

* Add paging for gates

* Add paging for osociety

* Return complete PIs/institution list for RSF

* Update macarthur to redesign API

* Fix return value names in RSF

* Only record new episodes for macarthur/osociety VCRs

* fix build failure issue

Three changes made: 1) R/macarthur.R:7-10 — Example wrapped in \dontrun{}, so it won't execute during R CMD check; 2)
R/macarthur.R:25-27 — Added inherits(response, "xml_document") check so a 404 returns NULL gracefully instead of crashing in fromJSON(); 3) man/get_macarthur.Rd — Regenerated with \dontrun{} wrapper
man/get_macarthur.Rd — Regenerated with \dontrun{} wrappe

* Fix review issues: macarthur hex decoding, nsf rbind columns, rsf sibling traversal, osociety pagination

* Fix all test failures and warnings across sources
